snippet.title: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics - Coming to Steam Autumn 2026 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Infinity: HexaDome Tactics on Steam: https://hexadomeplay.online/ByVXG9

Infinity: HexaDome, a sci-fi turn-based arena tactics game, is getting closer to its release. After years of development, numerous playtests, and community-driven reworks, the game is finally ready to launch on Steam Autumn 2026.

This all-new trailer showcases the game’s visual progress, turn-based arena tactics gameplay, and includes commentary from Blindspot Games, an indie studio behind HexaDome Tactics. Walking through key changes and improvements, devs also highlight the impact of community feedback - from early feedback to playtest impressions - on the game’s evolution into a more exciting tactical experience.

Infinity: HexaDome Tactics is a 1v1 turn‑based tactics game with fast-paced battles in a sci-fi arena of a future combat show. Build your roster of champions and outmaneuver your opponent in PVE or PVP mode. Take out rivals, capture zones, hit sponsor objectives, work the crowd, and chain the perfect turns when it matters most.
